stage1.impression: A clean, dark launch-style studio frame: one red acrylic speaker centred on a near-black seamless, with a soft glow behind it and a long red reflection in a glossy floor. It still reads as CG, though. The speaker is small in the frame (about 14% of the width, 47% of the height). Its horn reads as glossy red chrome: a blown pink face with a black reflected throat, not tinted acrylic. The right side of the cabinet falls into near-black, so the silhouette loses its right edge. The background carries a slight magenta cast, and the floor beside the speaker is a black void, so the speaker floats on its reflection rather than standing on a surface.

blocking_9: Speaker fills about 55-65% of the frame height, so the woofer, ring and horn read at homepage size
Horn reads as tinted acrylic with readable depth, not mirror chrome: no clipped mouth face and no black hole of reflected void (horn region clip_pct < 1.5, crush_pct < 8)
Both vertical edges of the cabinet traced by light: right edge p95 >= 110, matching the left edge's rim
Neutral seamless with no magenta cast (background delta_e2000 < 2 against neutral grey)
Floor reads as a surface at the speaker's base (lum 5-14 beside it), with a visible contact shadow and a faint, short reflection

defects.what: Speaker too small for a hero frame: about 185 x 337 px of 1280 x 720
Horn mouth blown out (5.5% clipped) with a large black reflected void (18% crushed). Reads as red chrome or plastic, not acrylic
Right side of the cabinet and its right edge sink to black (median 7-23, p95 44). No rim, so the silhouette dissolves into the background
Background magenta cast: RGB 22/18/22, delta_e 3.95 against neutral
Floor crushed to pure black (98% crushed). No surface reads, so the speaker sits on a void
Floor reflection long and strong (p95 66, red 57) for a 'faint' reflection; it competes with the product's base
Hard white vertical line on the left edge (p95 244), next to a dark right edge: the lighting is lopsided
The base's internals (ports, bracing, white blocks) read as busy clutter through the acrylic. This is the product itself; see out_of_scope

changes.problem: The speaker is too small to be the hero of a launch page; detail in the woofer, ring and horn is lost.

evidence.measured: Product bbox about 185 x 337 px in 1280 x 720: 47% of the height, 14% of the width

changes.expected: The speaker fills about 58-60% of the frame height and stays centred, with generous negative space left and right for type.

changes.problem: The upper-left sheen panel reflects across the horn mouth as a blown pink sheet, and the rest of the mouth mirrors the black void, so the horn reads as chrome.
changes.expected: The mouth carries a graded highlight rather than a clipped sheet, and the acrylic glows from behind, filling the dark throat with red transmission.

changes.problem: The right side and right edge of the cabinet fall to near-black, so the silhouette is traced on one side only.
changes.expected: A clean red rim traces the right vertical edge, about half as bright as the left rim, and the silhouette closes.

changes.problem: The seamless carries a magenta cast, which reads as a grading error and will tint all eight colourways.

evidence.measured: RGB 22/18/22, delta_e2000 3.95 vs #141414; glow region 32/28/32, delta_e 4.35 vs #1E1E1E

changes.expected: A neutral charcoal background with R, G and B within 1 of each other.

changes.problem: The floor beside the speaker is crushed to black, so nothing reads as a surface and the contact shadow has nothing to darken: the speaker floats.
changes.expected: A dim charcoal floor pool around the base (lum 6-12) that falls to black at the frame edges. The contact shadow reads as a darker line under the plinth.

changes.problem: The floor reflection is long and strong, competing with the base instead of being a faint echo.

evidence.measured: lum p95 66.4, red median 57; the profile stays flat at about 17 down to the frame bottom

changes.expected: The reflection is about half as bright and slightly blurred, and it fades out within about a third of the product's height below the base.

changes.problem: The wall glow is a tight halo that falls off quickly; the rest of the backdrop is flat dark. The frame lacks the soft, wide luminous wall of an Apple hero.

evidence.measured: Profile falls 50 -> 2.9 over about 320 px; top background 19, glow 29

changes.expected: A broader, smoother halo centred slightly lower behind the cabinet, falling off gently to the frame edges with no banding.

changes.problem: The left rim is a hard clipped white line, much hotter than anything else on the speaker, and it reads as a CG edge light.

evidence.measured: p95 244, clip 1.16%, versus a right edge p95 of 44

changes.expected: A bright but unclipped rim on the left, balanced against the new right rim from c3.

out_of_scope.request: Calm the base's visible internals (white blocks, ports, bracing) seen through the acrylic
out_of_scope.why: They are the speaker's own parts and tint, which are fixed. Lighting can only lower their contrast.

out_of_scope.request: A less extreme turn (rotate_z about -25), so the horn mouth presents more frontally
out_of_scope.why: Allowed as set or camera, but it changes all eight frames. Try it only if c2 does not cure the chrome read.
